thread:
Kevin: Heads-up: POC with Northgate wants to replace CompetitorX with Redwood. Need to confirm compat bridge, pricing delta, and answers for their security questionnaire. POC target next Tue. Can SE + security weigh in?
Marta: +1. Can we do a quick SE sync tomorrow 11am? Primary asks I'm hearing: prompt mapping from /v1/generate -> our /v1/completions, streaming parity, stop token handling, and token billing expectations.
Li: Quick clarifying Q — do they expect token-for-token identical responses or just functionally equivalent outputs? If they want exact parity we'll need an adapter + reranker to emulate scoring.
Jamal: Security flag: they'll run our questionnaire and their compliance team will ask about data residency, KMS/HSM, audit logs, and options for a private deployment. I'll start drafting answers and loop infra.
Olivia: On pricing: they anticipate high throughput but are small org. Do we have a standard committed-capacity quote for ~100M tokens/mo? Also need to know reserved vs hosted SLA addons.
Marta: For the prompt mapping piece — we usually provide a thin shim that normalizes requests. Example mapping snippet below:
```
POST /v1/generate
Body: {"prompt": "...", "max_tokens": 200}
Translate -> POST /v1/completions
Body: {"input": prompt, "length": max_tokens}
Headers: {"X-Correlation": "...", "X-Original-Model": "comp-x-1"}
```
This preserves stop-sequence handling and lets us control token counting.
Kevin: Good. Is there an automated test harness we can hand them to demonstrate parity? Even a small smoke that runs 50 prompts and diffs responses would help the POC.
Li: Yes — we can use the internal "parity-checker" Garret built. I'll package it as a GH gist + docker image. It runs a prompt set, normalizes whitespace, computes token delta, and reports semantic diffs (normalized BLEU/ROUGE-ish).
Jamal: Security notes to include in the questionnaire: supported KMS (AWS KMS, GCP CMEK), audit log retention (90d by default), private deployment options (VPC/on-prem available), and pen-test coordination window. I'll prep a short doc.
Olivia: I'll draft a pricing outline. Ballpark ask: committed 100M tokens/month with 95th pct latency SLA — any guesstimate we can start with for sales?
Kevin: Ballpark for hosted baseline: $0.004 / 1k tokens. Reserved capacity typically gets ~20% discount on unit cost plus a reserved premium for capacity. SLA addon is separate. I'll ask finance to run a formal quote.
Marta: Action items recap:
- Li: produce parity-checker gist + docker image -> due Fri 09:00
- Jamal: complete security questionnaire draft with KMS/SOC2 scoping -> due Mon EOD
- Olivia: draft committed-capacity pricing and quote -> due Mon 12:00
- Kevin: assemble POC runbook (endpoints, smoke tests, rollback) and schedule SE sync -> due Mon EOD
Jamal: Tiny checklist I'll attach to the questionnaire answers:
```
- KMS providers: AWS KMS, GCP CMEK
- Audit logs: 90d retained in console + export option
- Private deploy: available (VPC + on-prem)
- Pen-test: 2 weeks notice, coordinate with security
```
Kevin: :thumbsup: Thanks all. I'll set the 11am SE sync invite and ping Legal for an NDA template.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy preview for parity-runner image -> tag parity-checker:20240123 placed in staging.
Marta: Great — I'll start prepping the prompt set (50-100 edge/typical prompts) and share in the gist.
Kevin: Perfect. If anything urgent pops up ping me in thread.
